robots.name: Koubu Kai — Sakura Unit
robots.art_brief: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reframe this exact pink Sakura Koubu Kai portrait, preserving robot, pink paint, two katana, both hands, geometry, steam fittings, lighting and studio. Pull camera back and keep both swords angled down so BOTH ENTIRE sword blades and tips are inside the square canvas with 7% clear space around them. Whole robot and both feet also fully inside with margin. No crop anywhere, no other change.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Koubu Kai — Sakura Unit fills the guarded contact anchor role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Warden tuning supports the melee equipment role; defensive stance and a 25% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Duo strategy tuning rules with the Warden Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

Two source slender katana held low, one in each mechanical hand. No pilot exposed, source stout proportions, no slender Gundam body.
